Name: (FS) Partners in Slime
Author: thesameplant
Description:
[size=5][b]✨ Adds simple, prismatic and tiger slime companion accessories. ✨[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]


[size=3][b]To install:[/b][/size]
Unzip the file and add it to your Mods folder.﻿
[size=1]The default location on Windows is C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods, but it may vary by operating system. That's just what it is on mine.


[/size][size=3][b]To use in game:[/b][/size]
1. Select the Hand Mirror (which comes with Fashion Sense and can be purchased at Pierre's General Store).
2. [u]Use different accessory slots[/u] to choose your slime base, and optionally, a bobble and/or a heart, or even both hearts!

[b]Slime options:[/b]
- Angry Colorable
- Angry Prismatic
- Angry Tiger
- Happy Colorable
- Happy Prismatic
- Happy Tiger

[b]Bobble options:[/b]
- Colorable
- Prismatic
- Star
- Tiger

[b]Heart options:[/b]
- High (to accommodate a bobble, or if you just like it higher)
- Low (works best with no bobble)



[size=4][b]Credits and Other Visible Mods:
[/b][/size]Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22585]Gabett's Frog Companion[/url] mod.
If you would prefer a Junimo friend, check out my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23377]My Friend Junimo[/url]!
